newsitem.title: USA: Willbros sees more engineering demand in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Willbros sees more engineering demand in 1997.

text.p: Willbros Group Inc said it sees an increased demand for engineering services and speciality services to support the oil industry in 1997.

Willbros said that the increased demand should mean more contract awards and better margins for the company, although did not provide any estimates. Company officials were not immediately available to comment.
The company also said it expects to bid on a number of major international construction projects in 1997. It said the the value of the bids will be the highest this decade.
The company is an independent contractor serving the oil and gas industry.
